verdict.rationale: CoreWeave's docs show that users can pick among multiple GPU instance types: Capacity Finder compares availability for "one or more GPU and CPU instance types," and Node Pools can run on different Node types. A community comment adds that the fleet is "all datacenter GPUs." However, the evidence never names specific GPU models or generations, so neither the current-generation line-up nor cheaper older options is shown. missing for 10: documented availability of H100/H200/B200-class GPUs, documented previous-generation GPU options and their pricing, a published GPU instance-type catalog, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can choose from current-generation datacenter GPUs (H100/H200/B200 class) as well as cheaper previous-generation options

citations.quote: use Capacity Finder in the Cloud Console to compare placement availability across Zones for one or more GPU and CPU instance types
This lets you run different types of workloads on different types of Nodes
Utilize on-demand GPU instances for additional workloads when you're not looking for long-term capacity commitments.
It's all datacenter GPUs as per their website.
